description: Types shared by every Eclogite component schema. Not a document type on its own.

name.title: Name
name.description: Catalog object name: lower case, digits, '.', '+', '_' and '-', at most 64 characters.

packageName.title: PackageName
packageName.description: Name of a package or a meta-package.

capability.title: Capability
capability.description:
Capability name such as `kernel`, `linux`, `init`, `libc`, `sh`, `vi`.
Capabilities share the package namespace.

aliases.description: Catalog-wide unique convenience names for CLI input. Not part of build identity and never inherited.

relativePath.title: RelativePath
relativePath.description: Relative to the defining document's directory; no leading `/`, no `..`.

guestPathPattern.title: GuestPathPattern
guestPathPattern.description: Absolute guest path, or a glob starting with two stars and a slash, matching anywhere in the output.

parameterName.description: An upper-case parameter name such as `CONSOLE`.

parameterReference.title: ParameterReference
parameterReference.description: A whole string that is one parameter, such as `${UID}`.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Values may use `${NAME}` for builder variables and package parameters.

value.title: Value
value.description:
Where a parameter comes from, and when it is known.

A build-time value is known when the system is compiled. It enters the
keys of the packages that read it.

A start-time value is known only when the runner starts the machine. It
never enters a key, an image or the compiled system, and it may be used
only in services, accounts, the hostname, endpoints and commands. A value
computed from a start-time value is itself start-time.

A plain JSON Pointer string is short for `{ "pointer": ... }`.

oneOf.description: Build time: from the resolved system, such as `/machine/resources/memory_mib`.

Start time: a setting of the software profile. `default` applies when
the profile declares no setting of that name. The value stays start-time
either way, so a package's key never depends on which profile uses it.
Start time: the account that runs the runner on the host.
`value * multiply / divide`, rounded down, for integers.
A crypt(3) SHA-512 hash of the value, with a fresh salt at each start.

parameters.description: Values exposed as `${NAME}`, keyed by upper-case names such as `CONSOLE`.

compiler.title: Compiler
compiler.description: OPEN(12): a closed v0.1 set here, and also listed by the toolchain.

imageSize.title: ImageSize
imageSize.description:
Image size: without `size_mib`, sized from the package outputs plus
`free_mib` (default 64). Setting both fields is an error.

factOperand.title: FactOperand
factOperand.description: A literal, or the value of another fact in the same scope.

predicate.title: Predicate

alternatives.title: Alternatives
alternatives.description:
Ordered alternatives: the first one in the selected set, else the first
whose constraints hold. At least two entries.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: A package, a capability, or ordered alternatives.

config.title: Config
config.description:
Settings required of a configurable provider. For `linux`, Kconfig options
such as `{ "CONFIG_9P_FS": "y" }`.

configuredReference.title: ConfiguredReference
configuredReference.description:
A dependency that requires config of its provider.
OPEN(10): `package` also holds capabilities, as in `{ "package": "linux" }`.

conditionalReference.title: ConditionalReference
conditionalReference.description:
A run dependency that applies only where `when` holds, requires `config`,
or both. At least one of the two is present.

builderTool.title: BuilderTool
builderTool.description: A program from the builder image's tool manifest, such as `builder:python3`.
